instruction: Use GIMP to set my image's color channels to 32-bit floating point depth.

metadata.explanation: While GIMP 2.10+ added support for higher bit depths, it has very limited support for 32-bit floating point operations and many filters and tools do not work properly with 32-bit float precision. Most professional workflows requiring true 32-bit float per channel editing (HDR photography, scientific imaging) cannot be reliably accomplished in GIMP due to incomplete implementation across its toolset. This makes the task effectively infeasible for production use in GIMP.
metadata.infeasible_reason: GIMP has incomplete 32-bit float support across tools and filters
